Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: After the Planner explicitly instructed cross-checking Mauro Scocco’s birth date with additional reputable sources (AllMusic, Discogs) to resolve the 1962 vs 1963 discrepancy (Step 6), the WebSurfer ignored those instructions and reopened the same Wikipedia page instead of consulting the requested alternative sources. This failure to follow the verification plan perpetuated the inconsistency and risked yielding the wrong birth year, directly jeopardizing the correctness of the final solution.
